aaa_enabled.summary: Configure centralized authentication (RADIUS or TACACS+) in Nokia SR OS.
cli: configure system security authentication-order tacplus radius local
aaa_enabled.notes: Verify that your remote server groups are configured before enabling authentication-order to prevent administrative lockout.

secure_vty_transport.summary: Restrict remote VTY access to SSH only by disabling Telnet.
secure_vty_transport.notes: Shutdown telnet-server and telnet6-server to enforce encrypted SSH-only administration.

vty_idle_timeout.notes: Specify the idle timeout in minutes (e.g. 15 minutes). Setting it to disable is insecure.

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Ensure administrative account passwords are encrypted.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: Nokia SR OS automatically hashes/encrypts all user credentials at rest.

no_default_snmp_community.summary: Change or remove default SNMP community strings.
cli: configure system security snmp no community "public"
configure system security snmp no community "private"
no_default_snmp_community.notes: Remove default communities and configure complex community strings.

http_server_disabled.summary: Nokia SR OS does not support an onboard HTTP web management server.
http_server_disabled.notes: The HTTP server feature is not supported/enabled in standard Nokia SR OS deployments.

cli: configure system security ssh no shutdown
ssh_version_2.notes: The SSH server must be shut down before changing the protocol version.

logging_enabled.notes: Define a syslog destination ID and map the event stream logs to it.

management_acl.summary: Restrict management access using Management Access Filters.
cli: configure system security mgmt-access-filter default-action deny
configure system security mgmt-access-filter ip-filter entry 10 create match src-ip 192.168.1.0/24 action permit
management_acl.notes: Ensure your current administration IP/subnet is explicitly permitted to prevent lockout.

cli: configure system login-control pre-login-message "Authorized Access Only."
login_banner.notes: Configure a clear legal warning message displayed before login prompts.

password_min_length.notes: Ensure passwords are set to a minimum of 8 characters or longer.

cli: configure system time ntp server 192.168.1.10 prefer
configure system time ntp no shutdown
ntp_configured.notes: Define preferred NTP servers and ensure the NTP daemon is administratively enabled.

no_write_snmp_community.summary: Restrict SNMP communities to read-only access.
cli: configure system security snmp community "your_community" access-permissions r
no_write_snmp_community.notes: Do not grant read-write-admin (rwa) permissions to SNMP communities.
